method.value: Fit a 2-D Bertola et al. (1991) rotation-curve model to the CO velocity map and subtract it to look for blue/redshifted residual patterns

evidence.quote: we can compare the CO rotation curve with a rotational velocity model based on the Hα kinematics and then subtract the model to analyse the velocity residuals

findings_qualitative.value: No significant residuals in NGC 7213, so probably no molecular outflow

evidence.quote: this result indicates that probably there is no molecular outflow in NGC 7213.
